pages.title: Thought Matrix
pages.text: A thought frozen in a lattice so that it can be copied, stored and read back. Each node holds a fragment of a pattern of neurons, and together they hold the idea whole. Holding it, I occasionally find myself remembering something I never thought.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Psionic Resonator, I pressed a Psionic Crystal against a Neural Lattice with Psionic Ether. The thought I was holding transferred into the lattice and stayed there, readable later by anyone who touched it.
Made in $(item)Psionic Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Psionics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Boltzmann Brain, Cognitive Singularity, Neural Organoid.
